title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — Rom 5: death passed to all because all sinned; omnes same men same way
pass_a_gloss: He turns to Rom 5: the Apostle takes the same 'all' the same way for death's transit and for 'they sinned.' 'Death passed to all because all sinned' keeps one set of persons in view.
pass_b_english: Meanwhile, do you not see that all men are taken in the same way by the Apostle, both when death passes into them and when he says they sinned? Death, he says, passed into all, because all sinned. In both places the word "all" signifies the same men, in the same way.
source_text: Interim nonne vides omnes homines eodem modo accipi ab Apostolo, cum in eos mortem transire, & cum eos peccasse dicit? Mors, inquit, in omnes transiit, quoniam omnes peccaverunt. Utrobique vox omnes eosdem homines, eodem modo, significat.

choices.choice: Same all for death-transit and peccaverunt
